patch.summary: Amplemarket migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Amplemarket by inventorying legacy sales-intelligence fields, mapping them to Amplemarket objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.
Success signal: prospecting works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Amplemarket migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Amplemarket; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Salesforce; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Outbound-led B2B teams investing in AI multichannel engagement outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.
If Amplemarket mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Apollo.io before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Salesforce in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Startup already list price annual; Growth/Elite are custom-quoted.

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Contact volume and included seats differ sharply by plan (27k / 140k / 400k contacts).

checklist.label: Mitigate: Not a full CRM pipeline system of record.

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
